messages:
Priya: quick preflight — we need a one-paragraph GA status + owners. small ask: ack here with a single acceptance line.

Sam: ack. i'll own perf targets, canary wiring, and model-fallback list. acceptance: perf tests passing in staging and automated rollback exercised.

Chris: ack. i'll own SLOs, alerts, and synthetic checks. acceptance: dashboards in staging + 48h green synthetic.

Lina: ack. docs runbook + customer one-pager assigned to me. acceptance: PR merged and published to docs site.

Alex: ack. pricing/commit tiers will be modeled; will share sensitivity table. acceptance: cost model + suggested public tiers reviewed.

Priya: compact checklist (owner):
- SLA/SLO definitions (Chris)
- Perf targets & rollback (Sam)
- Observability + smoke tests (Chris)
- Telemetry schema & keys (Sam)
- Runbook + customer comms (Lina)
- Support escalation matrix (Lina/Chris)
- Pricing + commit proposals (Alex)
- Canary plan + automatic fallback (Sam)

Sam: perf proposal: p99 <= 300ms standard, p95 <= 160ms low-latency tier; rollback if p99 > 25% above baseline for 10m or 5xx > 0.5% sustained. PR for telemetry + fallback list by 2026-05-25.

Chris: SLO draft: hosted SLA 99.9% monthly, error budget burn policy: require mitigation plan at 60% in 14d, immediate rollback at 90%. alerts: page on sustained p99 > 25% over target or 5xx > 0.2% for 5m. dashboards live in staging by 2026-05-28.

Lina: runbook skeleton will include detection, mitigation, rollback steps, customer comms templates, and postmortem checklist. target PR by 2026-05-27.

Alex: need pilot numbers (qps, avg tokens, model mix) to finalize pricing sims. Priya: please paste pilot usage here.

Priya: pilot: peak 550 qps, avg 75 tokens/request, model mix 60% large / 40% small, regional split 68% US / 32% EU.

Sam: telemetry keys i'll publish: token_count, model_variant, route, region, latency_ms, http_status, cache_hit. example event and schema PR coming.

Chris: monitoring deliverables: latency by region/model dashboard, error budget burn, synthetic per-region every 5m. acceptance: synthetic green 48h, alerts exercised in staging.

Priya: final asks — add a one-line acceptance under your owner item and post ack here when done. i'll assemble an exec one-pager afterwards.

Sam: acceptance added above.

Chris: acceptance added above.

Lina: acceptance added above. PR target met.

Alex: acceptance added — pricing spreadsheet shared for review.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-06-10T04:00:00Z -> 2026-06-10T08:00:00Z (5% -> 30%).

Priya: thanks everyone — i'll send GA readiness note once all PRs and dashboards are green. if anything slips, ping me immediately.
